title: Attention Is All You Need for Innovation Grant Forecasting

authors: Dr. Elena Rostova; Marcus Chen; Sophia Vance

abstract: An RLHF pipeline designed to align AI-assisted R&D roadmaps with strategic funding priorities and university technology transfer benchmarks.

authors: Kenji Takahashi; Lisa Monroe; David Vance
